description: For employee equipment, this checklist records business need, standard configuration, exception, data classification, shipping, access, support, and return trigger. Its supporting evidence includes manager approval, asset tag, serial, configuration record, security controls, delivery receipt, and condition photos.

title: Employee Equipment Checklist
use_case: Use the checklist during employee equipment request, custody, and return when the employee equipment record must identify employee, manager, role, location, device or asset, accessories, software, cost center, and employment event. Complete the applicable handoff for custody acknowledgment, inventory update, support handoff, return due date, recovered condition, and access deprovisioning.
